- So the **only** movable entity is the blue bar, and SPACE/MOUSE-on-bar have been no_impact every time.
I've tested 23 of 108 possible bar positions (rows {12..44}×cols {0..44}, step 4), including the entire col-28 column and col-36 rows 16/40/44. def barbox(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':

            return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None
probes=[('char',5,37),('cup1',55,21),('cup2',55,45)]
for name,r,c in probes:
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}], intent='explore')
    print(name, '->', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over')}, 'bar', barbox(current_frame))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
